entries.rationale: internal dispatch: lowerCall routes only the known date-function names here, and dateFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp (cerberus issue #2609) matches only when c.Func.Name is one of the same known names minus "timestamp" (its own guard excludes that one by name) — neither path can hand dateFnExpr a name it does not recognise

entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: lowerDateFnNoArg's sole caller, lowerDateFn, is reached only for the nine names lowerCall's switch routes to it (year, month, day_of_month, day_of_week, day_of_year, days_in_month, hour, minute, timestamp), and only when len(c.Args)==0. The vendored parser's function table (promql/parser/functions.go) pins `timestamp` at exactly one required argument (ArgTypes has length 1, no Variadic) — it can never reach lowerDateFn with zero args — while the other eight are Variadic:1 over a single ValueTypeVector ArgTypes slot, so the parser accepts them with 0 or 1 argument only; `name` therefore always comes from that same eight-name set when len(c.Args)==0. dateFnExpr's switch has an explicit case for each of those eight names (plus timestamp, which cannot reach it this way), so `dateFnExpr(name, now, now)` cannot return nil for any name lowerDateFnNoArg can be called with.
